test_udop_tokenizer_with_boxes: test the UdopTokenizer by encoding words with bounding boxes and verifying tokenization output
test_udop_batch_encoding: test batch encoding of multiple word sequences with their corresponding bounding boxes using batch_encode_plus_boxes
test_udop_padding_truncation: test padding and truncation behavior of UdopTokenizer with max_length and padding parameters
test_udop_special_tokens: test adding and handling special tokens like cls_token and pad_token in UdopTokenizer
test_udop_qa_encoding: test visual question answering encoding by combining a question string with document words and boxes
